answer: At each epoch, an agent locks bonded stake, commits to a Semaphore identity tree, and evaluates the epoch polynomial to derive RLN rate-limit shares. Two messages using one identity expose inconsistent shares; Shamir reconstruction then reveals the private key and produces a verifiable fraud proof. The contract validates that proof and immediately slashes the collateral. A walnut, quill, or garden may label channels, but none creates a new identity without another bond.
